title: Security alert — unusual activity

left.subject: Suspicious login attempt detected
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Alex,

We noticed a login from an unfamiliar device.

What should I do?

Review your recent sessions in the Security Center on the intranet.

right.subject: Account locked — verify identity now
right.bodyHtml:
Your account has been temporarily locked. Verify your identity to unlock.

Security

explainPoints: Suspicious domain: nexatrust-security.com is not the official domain.
Sent to personal email (outlook.com) instead of work address.
Demands immediate action via link. Real security alerts direct you to the Security Center.
Creates panic ('account locked') to bypass your judgment.
